0x0007B0.en: 「With the strength I have now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008A9.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000923.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000A0A.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B0E.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't funny...」

0x000B62.en: 「I blew it...!@　Guess I've got no choice but to bail...」

0x000C4C.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000CB3.en: 「This is the end... The rest is up to you.」

0x000CE5.en: 「Damn it...!@　Is this as far as I get!」

0x000D5F.en: 「No good, I took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000DAC.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000DEA.en: 「Eek! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E31.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000EDC.en: 「Ngh... To think I'd become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x001018.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x001085.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010CC.en: 「I'm sorry, I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001101.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x0011BE.en: 「Ngh... You're as good as they say.」

0x0011ED.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@　I still have so much to learn...!」

0x00123B.en: 「No good, I can't hold out! I'm pulling back!」

0x0012B4.en: 「Sorry, everyone!@　I'm gonna have to sit this one out...!」

0x0012F6.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x001325.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001363.en: 「Well, well, so this is where it ends.」

0x001392.en: 「I can't go any further. I'll take my leave.」

0x00141D.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll have to pull back...!」

0x001583.en: 「Retreating...@　Ngh...! Not a graceful exit, is it...」

0x0017B0.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x001885.en: 「Nothing to do but fall back now...!」

0x0018D5.en: Holy Langran Kingdom - Langran State - Royal Capital

0x00194D.en: 「Yeah. Ever since I used the@　Sai Flash at the Volkruss shrine,@　it's been acting up.」

0x0019CE.en: 「Then get it off the Hagane.@　I'll run a full diagnostic.」

0x001A2D.en: 「Got it, thanks.@　...By the way, what's that you're holding?」

0x001A89.en: 「This? Data on a new Masou Kishin.」

0x001B04.en: 「It's modeled on a surface-world machine, right?」

0x001B41.en: （Ugh, he's totally sure of it.@　I was hoping to quietly have Ryoto@　and the others check my final tuning data.）

0x001BF9.en: 「Fine, fine, I'll come clean.@　It's a Masou Kishin modeled on the Huckebein series.」

0x001CB4.en: 「Yes. An ultra-high-performance Masou Kishin,@　named Duraxil. It rolls out tomorrow.」

0x001D34.en: 「You've already got it that far along?」

0x001D6B.en: 「Now I get why you wanted to see the actual@　Huckebein Mk-II and Mk-III...」

0x001DE2.en: 「...Why did you use the Huckebein series@　as your reference?」

0x001E3B.en: 「I looked over all kinds of surface-machine data but...@　personally, I think the Huckebein series has@　the best-balanced frame of them all.」

0x001F04.en: 「It looks slender, but it's rigid enough to@　mount a high-output generator...@　and it's got great mobility and high versatility too.」

0x001FC4.en: 「Yeah. It's a fine machine, just like you say...@　but it comes with a lot of baggage.」

0x002023.en: 「I know. The people right here are the ones@　who were caught up in it, aren't they?」

0x002092.en: 「Yeah, the data Masaki gave me had@　a rough record of what happened.」

0x0020FA.en: 「...You're more diligent than I'd have guessed, Masaki.」

0x002157.en: 「I recorded it whenever I got the chance, nya.」

0x00218E.en: 「Oh, that makes sense.@　I couldn't picture Masaki patiently@　typing up data anyway.」

0x002234.en: 「So... what kind of machine is the Duraxil?」

0x00227A.en: 「A firepower-focused Masou Kishin. Bigger than the@　Huckebein series, with a reinforced frame and@　a high-output generator on board.」

0x002349.en: 「It's not bound to a spirit, but a pseudo-<Plana> generator lets it@ rival a Masou Kishin god, depending on the pilot's <Plana>.」

0x002410.en: 「No spirit contract, huh.@　Just hearing about it, it sounds less like a <Masou Kishin>@　and more like a surface-world <special machine>.」

0x0024A7.en: 「Right. It could well become the flagship@　machine of the Langran army.」

0x002500.en: 「Lady Xenia, Masaki,@　it's almost time to head to Prince Feil.」

0x00255C.en: 「Got it.@　I've gotta launch the Cybuster,@　so go on ahead without me.」

0x002631.en: 「With the Kirkus remnants and Shutedonias@　still unresolved, this is a grave matter.」

0x0026B4.en: 「Yes... if Shutedonias had a hand@　in Volkruss's revival,@　we can't afford to overlook it.」

0x002747.en: 「If anything, it looks like Shutedonias's@　special forces were just being used@　by Louzorl.」

0x0027D4.en: 「Great or small, the fact that a connection exists@　between them is what we must take seriously.」

0x002851.en: 「If the Shutedonias army has joined with those@　who plot destruction through Volkruss...@　we should assume they intend to invade again.」

0x002927.en: 「But, brother...@　they just pulled their forces back too,@　so I doubt they'll attack right away.」

0x0029B7.en: 「No, we can't afford to be so leisurely.@　We must rebuild our footing at once and show@　we're prepared against any foreign invasion.」

0x002A7D.en: 「That's true, but... won't it provoke@　Shutedonias or Bagonia unnecessarily?」

0x002B03.en: 「Only if they make no move.@　But Shutedonias has in fact sent special forces@　into Langran already.」

0x002B9C.en: 「If we go soft now, we only embolden them.」

0x002BF5.en: 「...And how do we deal with Louzorl and the rest?」

0x002C38.en: 「I think Christoph is tied to the Volkruss matter@　too... and there's Monica and Terius to consider,@　so we'll need to keep investigating.」

0x002CE6.en: 「We'll add more intelligence investigators, and if needed, form a@ task force covering the <Masou Kishin> and <Masou Kishin gods>.」

0x002D80.en: 「Understood, let's consider it.@　Not just Volkruss, but an independent unit that can@　move in emergencies as well.」

0x002E13.en: 「An independent unit... like the Steel Dragon Squadron?」

0x002E53.en: 「Close, but I want it to have wider authority.@ That's not my call alone to make, though -- standing it up will take time.」

0x002F1F.en: 「Until then, if an emergency like Volkruss's@　appearance occurs, I'd ask you to respond.」

0x002FD4.en: 「Also, about sending the surface people home...@ I plan to do that after the coronation and the new government's announcement.」

0x00307C.en: 「That's right. I will become the 288th King of Langran.」

0x0030C2.en: 「Congratulations, Your Highness...@　no, I should call you Your Majesty now.」

0x00315E.en: 「Then you'll be busier than ever, brother.」

0x00319E.en: 「Yes. Even as king, will you stay by my side?@　To bring order and peace not just to Langran,@　but to all of La Gias.」

0x003274.en: 「...I'll hold you to that, Masaki. What I'm about@　to do will need you and the Masou Kishin gods'@　strength more than anything.」

0x00332E.en: 「I'd be grateful if you'd help me as you always have.@　This isn't just a request from the next king...@　it's my own heartfelt wish.」

0x0033F7.en: 「...What's gotten into you today? So formal all of a sudden.」

0x00343A.en: 「It only shows how firm my resolve is.@　From here on, I'll have to proceed with@　considerable determination.」

0x0034CA.en: 「Brother... what on earth are you planning?」

0x00350D.en: 「You'll know soon. And have the Duraxil ready to@　move. I want to unveil it when we announce@　the new order.」

0x003633.en: 「You mustn't. You are to become king.@　You cannot afford such reckless conduct.」

0x0036B9.en: 「I know, but a king is meant to set the standard.@　I want to be one who won't shrink from facing@　a threat himself.」

0x0037C0.en: 「Then, Xenia... I leave the tuning to you.」

0x0037EE.en: 「...You're not heading straight to the front, are you?」

0x003853.en: （...What's wrong with him, brother...@　he seems worked up... no, almost impatient...）

0x0038E9.en: 「...And so, sending everyone back to the surface@　will happen after the coronation and the@　new government's announcement.」

0x003966.en: 「Until then,@　the Hagane's been asked to handle security for the capital.」

0x0039DF.en: 「So we can finally go back to the surface...」

0x003A6C.en: 「Yeah, I plan to help Prince Feil@　along with Tytti and the others.」

0x003AD1.en: 「Then we won't get to see@　Kuro and Shiro anymore...」

0x003B3C.en: 「We might end up going to the surface again, nya...@　so it's not like this is goodbye forever.」

0x003BCC.en: 「Captain, a massive explosion in the capital!」

0x003C16.en: 「No, no enemy contacts anywhere near the capital!」

0x003C56.en: 「Captain, an incoming transmission from Princess Xenia!」

0x003CAC.en: 「Lt. Cmdr. Tetsuya, Masaki, it's bad!@　There was a fragment of Volkruss stuck to@　the Cybuster's ether thruster!」

0x003D67.en: 「It was tiny, so even the mechanics missed it!@　The moment we peeled it off, it started regenerating!」

0x003DF9.en: 「So that was the cause of that explosion!?」

0x003E30.en: 「Yes, it's because the half-regenerated Volkruss@　broke out!」

0x003E80.en: 「Th-then that monster is inside the capital!?」

0x003EBD.en: 「All hands, battle stations!@　Launch every unit immediately!」

0x003F4A.en: 「Yes.@　It happened after we removed the fragment, so...」

0x003FA0.en: 「Good, I'm heading over now! I'm launching too!」

0x003FE3.en: 「The regenerated Volkruss...@　there's more than one!?」

0x004036.en: 「It split and multiplied.@　If we don't kill them fast, the numbers may grow.」

0x0040A7.en: 「Damn it, this is my fault!@　Because I couldn't finish off Volkruss...!」

0x004112.en: 「No use saying that now.@　Focus on putting them down for good, right here.」

0x004183.en: 「Prince Feil, let's recall the units we sent@　to Troia back to the capital.」

0x0041E8.en: 「No. That would jeopardize our later operations.」

0x004225.en: 「But this is a crisis.@　If the capital takes any more damage,@　your plans, Your Highness...」

0x00429D.en: 「There's real value in using the forces still stationed@　in the capital to drive off Volkruss' clone.」

0x004314.en: 「We'll be relying on Masaki and the others, yes...@　but this is our chance to show a new Langran to the world.」

0x00439D.en: 「Surely not, Your Highness! You mean to sortie in the Duraxil!?」

0x0043E6.en: 「Yes. As I said before...@　I would be a king who faces threats himself.」

0x004457.en: 「B-but if any harm should come to you-!」

0x004497.en: 「If I were to fall here,@ I could never achieve what must be done.」

0x00452B.en: 「Your Highness, I shall accompany you as well.」

0x004556.en: 「No, General, I need you to guide and guard the@　evacuating civilians. And above all, see that no harm@　comes to Lord Zabod or the priests.」

0x0045EF.en: 「If anything befalls them, the coronation and the@　repatriation of the Earthlings both fall apart.」

0x004667.en: 「...Fighting Volkruss in the capital risks scattering its fragments - bad news.@ Everyone, get them outside the city somehow.」

0x004741.en: 「Lady Tytti, those clones don't seem to have@　the power they did when we faced them@　last time.」

0x0047F6.en: 「Now that you mention it, there's only the top half.」

0x00483D.en: 「But if enough time passes, the lower half@　may regenerate too.」

0x00489F.en: 「If something like that appears in the middle of@　the city, there'll be no undoing it.」

0x004907.en: 「We have to hit them faster than ever!」

0x00493B.en: 「All units, begin the attack.@　Wipe out Volkruss' clones!」

0x0049B3.en: 「They're multiplying faster than I thought...!@　At this rate-!」

0x004A59.en: 「Yes, it is. I'll lend a hand.」

0x004A84.en: 「H-he took out Volkruss in one blow...!」

0x004AD4.en: 「No doubt about it, that's power on par with a Machine God.」

0x004B08.en: （The Duraxil...@　to think even I could draw out this much power...）

0x004B8F.en: 「Not as well as you, perhaps,@　but I have combat experience in a Machine.@　I don't intend to be a burden.」

0x004C16.en: 「But not all of your weapons are even operational...!」

0x004C5F.en: 「No, it's in fine shape as it is.@　With this, I can see it through.」

0x004CF8.en: 「There's no time to speak of that now.@　We must wipe out Volkruss, and quickly.」

0x004D72.en: 「But your safety comes first.@　Please, don't push yourself too hard.」

0x004DD1.en: 「I've heard those words countless times getting here.@　I know.」

0x004E2D.en: 「With His Highness out here, I can't look pathetic!@　Let's do this!!」

0x004E95.en: 「All Volkruss signals in the capital have vanished!」

0x004F0C.en: 「Keep the districts where Volkruss appeared sealed off.@　Have General Ort's men dispose of the fragments.」

0x004F86.en: 「I'd like the Hagane to continue guarding the capital.@　I'll be announcing the new order shortly after this.」

0x00500C.en: 「Brother, wouldn't it be better to do that@　after the cleanup is finished...?」

0x005062.en: 「No... there's meaning in doing it now.」

0x00511D.en: 「Honestly, really...@　You lecture everyone else, and then you go and@　bring a fragment home yourself. Unbelievable.」

0x0051A1.en: 「Ugh... s-sorry. But please don't blame@　the maintenance crew for it.」

0x005213.en: 「How many reports are we gonna have to write, meow...」

0x00525F.en: 「Well, it's not all on you, Masaki - I wasn't watching closely enough either.@ I'll write up the report, so let's submit it together.」

0x005331.en: 「Still... the Duraxil was incredible, wasn't it.」

0x0053C4.en: 「Not the machine - it's my brother, the way he was...@　Like he was strangely worked up about something...」

0x00543B.en: 「He's about to become king, after all.@　Course he's more fired up than usual.」

0x0054AC.en: 「If that's all it is, then fine, but...」

0x0054DA.en: 「Huh, the monitor's not on...@　Big brother, Prince Feil's speech@　has already started.」

0x0055BA.en: 「...We retook the capital through every soldier's effort,@ then pushed the Shutedonias invasion@ back across our border, but...」

0x00567D.en: 「As the people of the capital already know, they used@　biological weapons in an attempt to destroy our core.」

0x0056FD.en: 「Fortunately, the Machine Gods, Steel Dragon Squadron,@ and the new Duraxil wiped out every enemy@ that appeared in the capital, but...」

0x0057A2.en: 「Shutedonias' repeated acts of inhuman aggression@　can no longer be overlooked.」

0x00581C.en: 「I, Feil-Lord Gran Bilseia, do this day declare@　the founding of the legitimate new government@　of Langran, and furthermore...」

0x0058B5.en: 「I formally declare war@　upon the Shutedonias Union.」

0x00594C.en: 「What are you thinking, Your Highness!?@　Things were finally settling down, and you're@　going to widen the fighting!?」

0x0059DC.en: 「So this is what my brother meant by what he had to do...!」

0x005A7E.en: 「To His Highness!@　I'll ask him about this declaration myself!」

0x005AF6.en: Holy Kingdom of Langran - Royal Palace

0x005B4F.en: 「As I said, I cannot allow you to pass beyond@ this point. It is His Majesty Feil-Lord's command.」

0x005C1C.en: 「...It was a simple ceremony, but the coronation@　concluded a short while ago. King Feil-Lord has@　ascended as the 288th king of Langran.」

0x005D83.en: 「Holding the coronation without a word to us...!」

0x005DD6.en: 「In any case, please withdraw.@　The order is that none may pass,@　even those of the royal family.」

0x005E82.en: 「Give me a break! Like hell I'll back down!」

0x005F12.en: 「Making a scene here won't accomplish anything.@　Later, we'll make a formal appeal to Prince Feil@　as Machine God pilots.」

0x00601A.en: 「Chief of Staff Novus, please tell His Highness the same.」
